name: mikrotik-billing-system
description: Multi-tenant MikroTik ISP billing and network management platform

scripts.docker:build:host: docker build --network=host --target api -t mikrotik-billing-api:latest . && docker build --network=host --target worker -t mikrotik-billing-worker:latest . && docker build --network=host --target web -t mikrotik-billing-web:latest .
scripts.docker:host:build: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.host-build.yml build
